info.title: Escape Lab API
info.description: Server-authoritative API for Escape Lab. Answer keys, explanations and hints never leave the server before they are earned. All scoring is computed here from server timestamps.

get.summary: Liveness probe.
Public scoring rules, published verbatim so the ledger is never a surprise.

post.summary: Create a student account (teacher with invite code). 409 email_taken or, for a teacher, name_taken.
post.description: Errors: 400 validation_error (invalid body, an empty or invisible name, a name containing "(teacher #number)"), 403 invalid_invite, 409 email_taken (e-mail already registered; addresses are compared after Unicode NFC normalisation, trimming and lower-casing, so composed and decomposed spellings are the same account), 409 name_taken (teacher name already used by another teacher account, or the reserved demo teacher name), 429 too many registrations.

name.description: Display name, 1 to 80 characters with at least one visible character (a name made only of spaces, invisible, private-use or unassigned characters is a 400 validation_error). It cannot contain a "(teacher #number)" pattern, which is reserved for content-review records (400 validation_error; digits, brackets and "#" are compared after Unicode folding). A teacher name must also be unique among teachers once case, accents, spacing, punctuation, invisible characters, Cyrillic / Greek look-alikes and the Latin look-alikes I / l / 1 / | and O / 0 are folded, and the seeded demo teacher name is reserved: otherwise 409 name_taken. Bidirectional override, embedding and isolate controls (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) are refused (400 validation_error). Students may share names.

password.description: At least 10 characters, counted after Unicode NFC normalisation (the password is stored as NFC, so a decomposed "e" + accent counts once), of which at least 6 are visible: whitespace, zero-width, format and filler characters (U+200B, U+3164, U+2800 ...) do not count. 400 validation_error otherwise (the length floor is checked by the handler, after NFC, not by this schema).

teacherInviteCode.description: Required to create a teacher account.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a bearer token (7 days).
post.description: The e-mail is compared after Unicode NFC normalisation, trimming and lower-casing.

post.summary: One-click demo sign-in (student Alex Martin or teacher Dr. Claire Moreau). Only available when the server runs with DEMO_MODE=1.

get.summary: Current user with XP and level.
Dashboard: level, XP, streak, progress, continue and recommended mission.
Lab map: every lab with its state (completed, current, available, locked, coming_soon).
Lab lobby: missions with state, best score and the vault.
Code Vault: fragments found per lab. The code itself is never returned.

post.summary: Enter the exit code to unlock a lab. 422 on a wrong code; 429 after five wrong codes in ten minutes.

get.summary: All badges with earned state.
Competency percentages, strongest competency and improvement area.
Lab results once the lab is escaped: XP, accuracy, time, hints, ledger, competencies and the mission breakdown. 409 lab_not_escaped before that.
Leaderboard by XP. Other students appear as "Inès M."; your own row is always returned in `me`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: week = XP earned in the last 7 days; all = all-time (default).

parameters.name: cohort
parameters.description: class = students sharing a class with you (default); all = every student.

get.description: Requires a student account. `total` is the number of students in the cohort who have XP in the window (all-time or last 7 days): the same figure for every viewer. Students without XP are not ranked and are not listed; a viewer without XP still gets their own row in `me`, placed below everyone ranked (rank = total + 1).

get.summary: Profile: identity, XP and level, accuracy, average mission time, labs, badges and settings (language, sound, reduced motion, notifications).

put.summary: Update settings and identity. Only the fields you send change. A teacher rename can answer 409 name_taken.
put.description: Requires a signed-in account. Errors: 400 validation_error (invalid body, an empty or invisible name, a name containing "(teacher #number)"), 409 name_taken (another teacher account already uses this name, or it is the reserved demo teacher name), 429 too many writes.

name.description: Display name, 1 to 80 characters with at least one visible character (a name made only of spaces, invisible, private-use or unassigned characters is a 400 validation_error). It cannot contain a "(teacher #number)" pattern, which is reserved for content-review records (400 validation_error; digits, brackets and "#" are compared after Unicode folding). A teacher name must also be unique among teachers once case, accents, spacing, punctuation, invisible characters, Cyrillic / Greek look-alikes and the Latin look-alikes I / l / 1 / | and O / 0 are folded, and the seeded demo teacher name is reserved: otherwise 409 name_taken. Bidirectional override, embedding and isolate controls (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) are refused (400 validation_error). Students may share names. Keeping your own name, even spelled differently, is always allowed.

post.summary: Start a mission, or resume the attempt already in progress.

get.summary: Current state of an attempt: current step (with the hints already delivered on it, in level order, as step.hintsGiven), revealed values, timer, penalties.

post.summary: Submit the answer for the current step. Correct answers return the explanation and may return a code fragment.

response.description: Engine specific. point: {x,y} (0-100), or guided point: {points:{targetId:{x,y}}} / {selections:{targetId:string}}; these maps may be combined across observations. choice: {choice}. decision: {decision}. order: {order:[ids]}. match: {pairs:{leftId:rightId}}.

post.summary: Ask the Lab Assistant (BETA) for a hint. Costs 15 XP. Never returns the answer; falls back to the standard hint. The delivered text is stored and listed in attempt.step.hintsGiven from then on.

get.summary: Result screen payload: ledger, stats, badges, competencies.

post.summary: Join a class with its code.
Create a class and get its join code.
post.description: Requires a teacher account. A class name needs at least 2 visible characters (invisible ones do not count). A teacher cannot own two classes with the same name: 409 class_name_taken. Two names are the same when they differ only by case (including ß / SS and final sigma), by whitespace (any whitespace of any length counts as one space), by invisible characters (zero-width, soft hyphen, bidi and format characters, a stray combining U+0345 ypogegrammeni), by compatibility forms (fullwidth letters, ligatures, mathematical alphabets) or by Cyrillic / Greek look-alikes of Latin letters. Punctuation, accents, digits and the shapes I / l / 1 / | and O / 0 are significant, so "Section 1.2" / "Section 12" and "Year 1" / "Year I" are different classes. At most 50 classes per teacher: 409 class_limit_reached.

get.summary: Your classes.
Roster with progress, accuracy, XP, last activity and the needs-attention flag.
One student: metrics, labs, competencies and mission history.
get.description: Requires a teacher account. `history` lists the latest 20 completed attempts, newest first; `historyTotal` (integer, always at least `history.length`) is the number of all completed attempts of the student, so a client can say "latest 20 of N".

get.summary: Cohort analytics: first-attempt success per mission, weakest mission flagged, roster.
Internal: scientific approval status of every mission (draft, reviewed, approved). Never shown to students.

put.summary: Internal: move a mission through Draft, Reviewed, Approved. Approval requires a review first.

post.summary: Restore the demo student (Alex Martin) or the demo teacher (Dr. Claire Moreau: name, classes, content review) to the prepared presentation state. 403 for every other account.

get.summary: An uploaded picture. Public by id (128 random bits), immutable, served with a sandboxing Content-Security-Policy.

post.summary: Upload a picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 4 MB) as base64 or a data: URL. The type and size are read from the bytes; SVG is refused.
post.description: Requires a teacher account. 409 media_quota when the teacher's library is full.

get.summary: Your uploaded pictures and the quota.

delete.summary: Delete one of your pictures. 409 media_in_use while a room or a past attempt uses it.

get.summary: Built-in pictures a room may use without uploading, with their natural sizes, and the authoring limits.
Your rooms with status, quality score and attempt statistics.

post.summary: Create a room (draft): from a document, empty, or as an editable copy of a built-in mission (fromMission). Assigned to every class of yours unless classIds says otherwise.

doc.description: A room document: { title, summary, discipline, cover?, mode: escape|exam, timeLimitSec, shuffleQuestions, shuffleOptions, passPct, showFeedback, revealAnswers, vaultCode, maxAttempts, intro, outro, questions[] }. Question types: choice, truefalse, text, number, hotspot, order, match. Every question has id, type, prompt, points (1-100), hints (0-3), explanation, optional context, image and feedbackWrong. choice: options [{id, label, correct, trap?, feedback?}], multiple. truefalse: answer, trap?. text: accepted[], typoTolerance, traps [{answer, feedback}]. number: value, tolerance, unit?, traps [{value, feedback}]. hotspot: image (required), zones [{id, label, shape: circle {x,y,r} | rect {x,y,w,h}, trap?, feedback?}] in natural pixels of the image, tolerance (pixels, default 5), require: any|all, decoys (extra labels for the text alternative). order: items in the correct order. match: pairs [{id, left, right}]. An image is {media: uploadId, alt} or {asset: libraryId, alt}; its size is set by the server. Every problem is reported at once in error.details (400 validation_error). At most 40 questions.

get.summary: One of your rooms: full document (with answers), classes, quality check and statistics.

put.summary: Replace the room document. `version` must be the version you loaded (409 version_conflict otherwise). Attempts already started keep the version they started with.

delete.summary: Delete a room with all its attempts and results.

put.summary: Publish, unpublish (draft) or archive. Publishing needs at least one question, no quality error and one class (422 room_not_ready).
Choose the classes that can play the room (your own classes only).

post.summary: Copy a room into a new draft.

get.summary: The saved room as a student would receive it (no answers), for "play as a student". Nothing is recorded.

post.summary: Grade one preview answer exactly as for a student (verdict, trap, feedback, expected answer). Nothing is recorded.

get.summary: Results of a room: summary, every attempt, per-question success, trap rates, option picks, text answers and hotspot clicks (heatmap).
One student attempt on one of your rooms, answer by answer, with the expected answers.
Rooms your teachers published for your classes, with your best result and any attempt in progress.

post.summary: Start a room, or resume the attempt in progress. 409 attempts_exhausted when the teacher limited attempts.

get.summary: State of your attempt: current question (no answers), timer, progress, vault fragments.

post.summary: Answer the current question. Escape mode: right / wrong with feedback (trap feedback when you fell for a trap), retry until right. Exam mode: one answer per question.
post.description: Requires a student account. response by type: choice {choice} or {choices:[...]}; truefalse {value}; text {text}; number {value}; hotspot {x, y} (natural pixels) or {points:[{x,y}...]} or, as the text alternative, {zone} / {zones:[...]}; order {order:[...]}; match {pairs:{leftId: rightId}}. Ids are the ones of the question as you received it.

post.summary: Read the next hint of the current question (costs 10% of its points).
Enter the vault code assembled from the fragments. 422 wrong_code.

get.summary: Review of a finished attempt: score, every answer, explanations and (if the teacher allows) the expected answers.

HeaderTooLarge.description: Request Header Fields Too Large (the header block, for example an oversized Authorization value, is above Node's 16 KB limit). Answered by the HTTP server before the application runs: no body and no JSON error envelope. The same applies to the other protocol-level errors Node answers itself on any operation, for example a bare `400 Bad Request` for a malformed request line, header or HTTP version, or for a Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding conflict; these are not declared per operation. The UI never produces them.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (error code rate_limited). `error.details.retryAfterSeconds` and the Retry-After header say how long to wait.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again (a whole number, at least 1). When CORS is enabled the API sends Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After, so a browser script can read it.
